description: Issue an Ed25519-signed portable attestation for a memory entry. Returns envelope for offline verify; server does not store it. Compliance: GDPR Art. 5, 32. Cost $0.01 per call.

entry_id.description: UUID of the memory entry to attest. Must belong to owner_wallet.

owner_wallet.description: 0x-prefixed owner wallet. Only the owner can attest.

wallet_signature.description: EIP-191 signature over the attest message (entry, owner, content hash).

name: memory.attest

outputSchema.description: Portable Ed25519 memory attestation envelope. Never ciphertext.

envelope_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical full envelope.

note.description: Caller keeps the envelope; platform does not store it.

ok.description: True when the tool completed without a validation error.

payment.description: Settlement receipt after x402 or sandbox payment.

tool.description: Tool name that produced this payload.

title: Memory Attest
